statements.proposition: This change adds a line height property to the Text and BBText objects for multiline text, and existing projects/objects without the property keep working (backward compatible).
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Addition half is TRUE (both objects gain a lineHeight property, editor field, actions/conditions/expressions). Backward-compatibility half is an impact claim: old data defaults to 0 (= default line height), which supports it, but the diff to textruntimeobject.ts declares _lineHeight twice in the class and lineHeight twice in the same content type literal (likely TS duplicate-identifier build errors), so I could not settle it without building the whole GDevelop TS toolchain, which was not attempted. No concrete check settles the compat claim either way.
evidence: gh api pulls/7770/files: 11 files modified, covering Extensions/BBText/*, Extensions/TextObject/*, newIDE TextEditor.js and RenderedTextInstance.js; none added or removed
TextObject.cpp patch: DoUnserializeFrom uses GetDoubleAttribute("lineHeight", 0), so old projects load with 0

textruntimeobject.ts and bbtextruntimeobject.ts patches: lineHeight read as content.lineHeight || 0; renderers map >0 to the style lineHeight, 0 to undefined (BBText updateLineHeight sets the raw value, 0)

textruntimeobject.ts patch: '_lineHeight: float;' added near line 95 and '_lineHeight: float = 0;' near line 109 in the same class; 'lineHeight: number;' and 'lineHeight: float;' both added in the same content type literal
